acceptance_criteria.condition: The archive report recomputes the retained V7 raw-tree and result digests and preserves the frozen preregistration digest.
A timeout and a condition-difference violation both make V7 ineligible; the regression rejects partial effect analysis and verifies every listed contaminated baseline log.
The package documentation states the actual interrupted V7 outcome and prohibits Skill-effect, repair-success, or general causal-capability claims from it.
The updated package passes its existing full test suite and type check without changing frozen V7 trial artifacts.

invariants: The frozen V7 preregistration, result, and raw condition artifacts are retained byte-for-byte and are never retried, resumed, or partially analyzed.

safeguards.name: frozen raw evidence
safeguards.rationale: The report stores the raw-tree and result SHA-256 digests and the regression recomputes both before accepting the archive.

safeguards.name: complete-pair gate
safeguards.rationale: The test requires 16 captured records, 15 complete records, exactly one timed-out baseline, and an ineligible result; it cannot reinterpret the partial set as a statistic.

safeguards.name: condition-isolation gate
safeguards.rationale: The archive and test identify six baseline stderr artifacts that read the global Skill, so the preregistered treatment difference is explicitly marked invalid.

safeguards.name: blind-claim boundary
safeguards.rationale: The README and archive state that V7 supports no Skill-effect, model repair-success, or general causal-capability claim.

design_boundary.rationale: The archive owns collection validity and evidence eligibility; the runner and scorer remain unchanged and V8 remediation is staged separately.

dependency_audit.rationale: No dependency, lockfile, or external service is added or changed.

extension_decision.rationale: The change adds a version-specific archive and regression, not a public extension point.

data_ownership.rationale: Raw logs, result, and preregistration are authoritative historical evidence; the interruption report is a derived integrity record tied to their hashes.

error_model.rationale: Agent timeout and condition-difference contamination are distinct invalidity classes; neither is reclassified as a repair failure or success.

contract_evolution.rationale: The frozen V7 protocol contract is not rebound to a repaired runner; any future collection requires a new V8 envelope and corpus.

operational_budget.rationale: The 180-second timeout is recorded as an observed boundary failure, and the next collection is required to preregister a larger budget before trial start.

threat_boundary.rationale: The archive preserves the hidden-scorer boundary and treats global Skill discovery as a protocol contamination, not as an analyzable treatment effect.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: Archive, regression, README, and evidence are one atomic, verified Git change; no unrelated work is included.

release_recovery.rationale: This is an offline evaluation archive with no production rollout or user-facing release.

data_migration.rationale: No application schema, persistence format, or user data is migrated.

configuration_secrets.rationale: No secret is stored; the observed global Skill-loading configuration boundary is recorded as a required isolation control before V8.

dependency_supply_chain.rationale: No package or supply-chain input changes.

operational_knowledge.rationale: README, interruption report, raw stderr, regression test, and this evidence ledger preserve diagnosis, ownership, and next-run prerequisites.

reproducibility.rationale: The archive includes immutable hashes, fixed task/result paths, deterministic digest code, and exact commands for targeted, full, and type-check verification.

remaining_risks: V7 cannot establish whether the Skill improves repair success or causal-analysis quality because its treatment difference was not isolated and its fixed paired collection was incomplete.
The runner's relative -o output path omitted agent-output.md from captured artifacts; V8 must correct and preflight this evidence path before collection.

A global git diff --check reports trailing whitespace present in immutable captured raw logs. The raw logs are retained byte-for-byte; only the authored closure files receive the scoped whitespace check.
The Codex Skill-isolation mechanism is not yet proven; do not create or run a formal V8 preregistration until an isolated preflight and regression test pass.

causal.symptom: V7 cannot support a paired Skill-effect estimate because one planned condition timed out and baseline conditions were not isolated from the global Skill.
causal.discriminating_check: Recompute the result/raw/preregistration hashes, inspect every incomplete trial, and scan the baseline stderr artifacts for the global Skill path before any effect analysis.
causal.upstream_path: Codex invocation/configuration -> Skill discovery and treatment boundary; Agent timeout budget -> incomplete condition -> fixed-pair eligibility decision
causal.timeline_evidence: The frozen preregistration predates collection; result.json records the first incomplete condition at 180.331 seconds; raw baseline stderr records the global Skill read and timeout; the archive test reproduces those facts without changing source.
